# A vdom unit spec can run before the Helper's lazy StringFromVnode loads

## Context

On #19607's Engine Tests run 38153117809 (head `e73c8b6586`, 2026-10-11 15:55Z), the `unit` job failed on one flaky test while 4,871 passed. The PR is docs-only:

`test/playwright/unit/vdom/HelperMoveIntoInsertedSubtree.spec.mjs` › "VdomHelper — a node moving into a freshly inserted subtree › after a text child, the move lands behind the text's closing comment"
`Error: VDom Helper render utilities are not loaded yet!`

The retry passed. The job still fails on a flaky test, so any PR can turn red on it, release-day PRs included.

## The Problem

`src/vdom/Helper.mjs` loads its render utility lazily: `importUtil()` runs from `initAsync()` and does `await import('./util/StringFromVnode.mjs')` when `useDomApiRenderer` is false. `create()` throws "VDom Helper render utilities are not loaded yet!" if `Neo.vdom.util.StringFromVnode` is still missing (`Helper.mjs:238-239`). The spec sets `useDomApiRenderer: false` and calls `VdomHelper.create` synchronously in its first test. Nothing makes that test wait for the dynamic import, so whichever finishes first decides the result.

I authored the spec in #19191.

## The Architectural Reality

Seven vdom specs set `useDomApiRenderer: false`. Five of them (`Advanced`, `Calendar`, `FragmentHelper`, `FragmentMoves`, `Helper`) import `src/vdom/util/StringFromVnode.mjs` statically. The import registers `Neo.vdom.util.StringFromVnode` before any test runs, and `importUtil()` then skips the dynamic load. `DeltaGrammar.spec.mjs` is a pure-module test that never calls `Helper.create`. `HelperMoveIntoInsertedSubtree.spec.mjs` is the only one that calls `create` without the static import.

## The Fix

Add `import StringFromVnode from '../../../../src/vdom/util/StringFromVnode.mjs';` to the spec, the same line as `Helper.spec.mjs:17`. Test-only, no engine change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The spec imports `StringFromVnode` statically, as its five siblings do. (#19613, merged as `2381d1c175`)
- [x] Ten fresh-process runs of the spec pass. The PR records the before and after base rates of the first test from fresh-process runs. (#19613 Test Evidence: 10/10 after; 10/10 before in isolation, so the mechanism probe carries the evidence: the util was absent at module evaluation and present at the first test, 3/3, and present at module evaluation after the fix)

## Out of Scope

Making `Helper#create` await its own utility. The engine's lazy load is deliberate: `create` is synchronous, and every renderer-specific spec preloads its utility.

## Related

#19191 (the spec's origin), #19607 (where it surfaced)
